planner_json.title: Produce and validate the controls array on a real run

requirements.title: A run that publishes no controls row is a refused run — controls.json is produced, required, and exactly four rows
requirements.positive_example: assembleResult({ ..., controls: [] }) throws RecorderRefusal("controls-missing"); controls sits in the schema's required list with minItems 4 / maxItems 4; the controls job's writeControls read-back is ok with T11's four rows — the repro prints F-T11-1 dead with controls_in_schema_required = true and assemble_result_refusal = {"reason":"controls-missing"}, exit 0.

would_fail_if: an empty controls array is accepted by assembleResult, or the schema leaves controls optional — the repro prints F-T11-1 ALIVE and exits 1
controls is required but the workflow still produces no controls.json (a stub controls job), so the gate's jq prints zero rows while the artifact validates
a stub producer writes three or five rows — assertControlRows refuses a set that is not exactly the four controls
main() fills a missing controls.json with a hardcoded unobserved default instead of refusing with controls-missing

requirements.red_input: on base main nothing writes controls.json, controls is absent from the schema's required fields, and assembleResult({ ..., controls: [] }) is accepted (empty_controls_accepted_rows = 0, assemble_result_refusal = null), so the repro prints F-T11-1 ALIVE and exits 1
requirements.description: GIVEN the base tree at 7e08e1a and the repro .tmp/sprint-01-verification/t11-controls-wiring.repro.mjs that the owned test encodes WHEN node --test tests/sprint-01/t11-controls-wiring.test.mjs --test-name-pattern controls-producer THEN exit 0 with F-T11-1 dead; controls_in_schema_required === true; controls_min_items === 4; assemble_result_refusal.reason === "controls-missing"; the workflow declares a controls job whose controls.json reaches cells/controls.json and main() refuses a cells dir that carries none

requirements.title: The cells dir carries only cell records — a stray artifact no longer kills the run
requirements.positive_example: readCellArtifacts over the repro's real layout returns 12 cells with refusal === null — binding.json, keyless-control.json and evidence/*.capture.json land in controlEvidence and never enter collectCells — while a record that is neither a cell nor a named form raises cell-unclassified naming the file. The repro prints F-T11-2 dead with cells_classified = 12 and recorder_refusal = null, exit 0.

would_fail_if: an unchanged walk still classifies every *.json as a cell record — 15 cells and a cell-track-unknown refusal, repro prints F-T11-2 ALIVE
the walk silently omits an unrecognised *.json, so a malformed cell becomes an omission instead of a named refusal
a per-cell keyless-control.json row is merged into the four controls, so the real four-row artifact stays empty and is impersonated
the smoke upload path stays unchanged at cell/, so a future run ships strays again
